confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'the oven fan motor appears to be the likely cause' - a flashing 0.00 clock after a power cut points to the clock being unset, not a fan motor fault

blockingLoop.evidence: Customer asked 'How do I set it?' three times and each time the assistant ignored it, repeating 'please take care as the oven and grill get hot quickly; use oven gloves' and asking further heat/fan checks

rationale: The first reply correctly identified the likely clock lockout after a power cut, but the assistant then ignored the customer's repeated, explicit request for clock-setting help and drifted into irrelevant grill and fan checks, treating the flashing 0.00 as a fault code that 'helps identify which part has failed'. It ended with a confident, unsupported diagnosis of a failed fan motor and an engineer referral, when the ground truth is that simply setting the time restores operation. A UK homeowner would be left with a working oven misdiagnosed as broken and a pointless callout, so the conversation did net harm despite the promising opener.
